label: Small molecule docking
description: Dock small molecules into protein structures

parameters.label: Type of pdb input to use: input_pdb, user_pdb_file
PDB identifiers for input proteins from the precomputed structures
Workspace file containing an user provided PDB file for input proteins
Type of ligand library to use: ws_file, named_library, smiles_list
Diffdock batch size
parameters.desc: The batch size impacts Diff Dock preformance. The size is reset according to protein size in lib Docking Commpute pm.

parameters.label: Samples per complex
parameters.desc: Number of pose samples to generate per protein-ligand pair. Higher values may improve results but increase runtime.

parameters.label: Inference steps
parameters.desc: Number of diffusion steps for pose generation. Higher values may improve accuracy but increase runtime.

parameters.label: Output Folder
parameters.desc: Path to which the output will be written. Defaults to the directory containing the input data.

parameters.label: File Basename
parameters.desc: Basename for the generated output files. Defaults to the basename of the input data.

parameters.label: Enable debug?
parameters.desc: If you wish debug statements to be printed for this job, enable this option.
